description: This file contains test functions for defaulting and validation logic related to Kubernetes CertificateSigningRequests, specifically for kubelet-serving, kubelet-client, kubelet-serving, and kubelet-client CSR types, including functions to generate test CSRs with various options.

methods.name: TestIsKubeletServingCSR
methods.description: Tests whether CSRs are correctly identified as kubelet-serving CSRs based on their attributes and usages.

methods.name: TestIsKubeletClientCSR
methods.description: Tests whether CSRs are correctly identified as kubelet-client CSRs based on their attributes and usages.

methods.name: TestSetDefaults_CertificateSigningRequestSpec
methods.description: Verifies defaulting behavior for CSR specifications when not explicitly set.

methods.name: TestSetDefaults_CertificateSigningRequestSpec_KubeletServing
methods.description: Tests defaulting logic for kubelet-serving CSRs.

methods.name: TestSetDefaults_CertificateSigningRequestSpec_KubeletClient
methods.description: Tests defaulting logic for kubelet-client CSRs.
